COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
16.06.2023 C24 No. 86 of 2022
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Dheeraj Joshi, Advocate,
holding brief of Mr. Abhishek Verma,
Advocate, for the applicant.
Mr. Ravi Joshi, Advocate, for the
respondent.
The instant Transfer Application
which has been preferred by the opposite
side to the proceedings under Section
13(1)(a) of the Hindu Marriage Act, in
Matrimonial Case No. 199 of 2022, Amit
Kumar Jain Vs. Charu Jain. The proceeding
has been instituted before the competent
Family Court at Haldwani, District Nainital.
The Application has been preferred
by the respondent wife under Section 24 of
the CPC, seeking transfer of the proceedings
to the competent Family Court at Dehradun
or at Haridwar.
Owing to the fact that since the
applicant contends that since she is a
resident of Saharanpur, it would be much
convenient for her to participate in the
proceedings, in case if the matter is
transferred to any other Court, which is
nearer to Saharanpur.
Today, when the matter was taken
up, upon mention being made by the
learned counsel for the parties, the
respondent's counsel has agreed that if the
Matrimonial Case No. 199 of 2022, Amit

Kumar Jain Vs. Charu Jain, which is presently
pending consideration before the Family
Court, Haldwani, District Nainital is
transferred to the competent Family Court
at Roorkee, he may not have any
grievances, as such.
Owing to the statement made by
the learned counsel for the respondent and
has also agreed by the applicant's counsel,
the Transfer Application is allowed. The
proceedings of Matrimonial Case No. 199 of
2022, Amit Kumar Jain Vs. Charu Jain, which
is presently pending consideration before
the Judge, Family Court, Haldwani, District
Nainital is hereby transferred to the
competent Court of equivalent jurisdiction
at Roorkee, District Haridwar.
Accordingly, C24 Application would
stand allowed.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 16.06.2023
Mahinder/
